questions.q: 6. In a certain code language, if ‘AMBER’ is coded as 36, ‘MAGENTA’ is coded as ‘57’, then what will ‘PURPLE’ be coded as ?
questions.s:
6.(a)
Logic :- (Sum of the place value of letters)- (Number of consonants)
AMBER :- (1 + 13 + 2 + 5 +18) - (3) ⇒ 39 - 3 = 36
MAGENTA :- (13 + 1 + 7 + 5 + 14 + 20 + 1) - (4) ⇒ 61 - 4 = 57
Similarly,
PURPLE :- (16 + 21 + 18 + 16 + 12 + 5) - (4) ⇒ (88) - 4 = 84

questions.q:
A roll number uses a variable structure based on the Region Code (first three digits):

Rule A: If Region Code starts with '5' (e.g., 5XX), Center Code is 5 digits long, immediately followed by a 2-digit Year Code.

Rule B: If Region Code starts with '8' (e.g., 8XX), Center Code is 4 digits long, immediately followed by a 3-digit Batch Code.

For roll number 592123456723, what are the digits of the Center Code?
questions.s:
Roll number: 592123456723

Region Code = first 3 digits = 592 (starts with 5, so Rule A applies).

After Region Code (3 digits): remaining = 123456723

Center Code = next 5 digits = 12345

Year Code = next 2 digits = 67

Remaining = 23

Answer: 12345

Without – ng ---------------------- (7)

Caused – pm ---------------------- (8)

From (1) and (3), we get:

Tension – sl ---------------------- (9)

From (5), (8) and (9), we get:

Frustration – jl ---------------------- (10)

Worry – yq --------------------- (11)

And – sm ---------------------- (1)

We get “yq tw fb sl’’ is the code of “Have Tension Worry Stress”.

questions_hin.q_hi: Which of the following can be coded as ‘’yq tw fb sl’’?
questions_hin.s_hi:
‘Frustration Have Caused Tension’ is written as ‘jl pm tw sl’ ---------------------- (1)

‘Caused Stress Without Worry’ is written as ‘fb yq pm ng’---------------------- (2)

‘Tension And Stress’ is written as ‘sm fb sl’ ---------------------- (3)

‘Without Have Caused’ is written as ‘pm tw ng’ ---------------------- (4)

From (1) and (4), we get:

Have – tw ---------------------- (5)

From (2) and (3), we get:

Stress – fb ---------------------- (6)

From (2) and (4), we get:

Without – ng ---------------------- (7)

From (1), (2) and (4), we get:

Caused – pm ---------------------- (8)

From (1) and (3), we get:

Tension – sl ---------------------- (9)

From (5), (8) and (9), we get:

Frustration – jl ---------------------- (10)

Worry – yq --------------------- (11)

And – sm ---------------------- (1)

We get “yq tw fb sl’’ is the code of “Have Tension Worry Stress”.
